summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 4 focused on (1) BITVERSE logo visibility with new cyan .logo-frame wrapper across Navbar/Home/About/Footer/Viewer, (2) Adesh Yash profile picture rendering on About 'Meet the Developer' section and Footer developer credit card, (3) mobile performance backdrop (starfield=25, tris=0, no spotlight on mobile), (4) PDF viewer using Google Docs Viewer (gview) on mobile and raw iframe on desktop. All 10 checks passed on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900).

issues: Non-blocking React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears from a select/option rendering somewhere; single console warning, does not affect functionality.

action_items: Optional: investigate the hydration warning about <span> child of <option> — likely a shadcn Select where a <span> icon is nested inside a native <option>; low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: Viewer.jsx correctly branches between mobile (gview) and desktop (raw) using UA + width check — works well.
Backdrop.jsx uses window.innerWidth < 768 || isTouchDevice() as isMobile; correctly reduces star count to 25 and triCount to 0 on mobile, and skips spotlight div. Confirmed visually.
index.css .logo-frame class provides cyan border + glow — makes the black-background PNG logo readable against dark theme; verified via screenshots on all pages.
About.jsx and Footer.jsx both consume DEV_PHOTO_URL for Adesh Yash's photo; the same image (naturalWidth=1260) loads correctly on both.
